**Every deviation from the skill's shibui SQL spec**

- **Spec field**: ADR% (filter 4.5/5.0) · **What was used instead**: ATR(14)/close*100 instead of mean 20d (high-low)/close
- **Spec field**: ADV$ · **What was used instead**: average_volume_30d_calc * close
- **Spec field**: volume > prev_volume (Bonde A) · **What was used instead**: volume > average_volume_10d_calc
- **Spec field**: adr_pct 20d (Bonde RB filter 6) · **What was used instead**: not evaluated in stage 1; see RB verification pass
- **Spec field**: RB filter 1 (5-day low) / 5 (2-3 day decline) · **What was used instead**: require price history -> Yahoo 3mo pass on candidates only
- **Spec field**: RB filter 8 (close vs close_20d_ago) · **What was used instead**: close >= SMA20*0.92 proxy
- **Spec field**: Sun J contraction_ratio < 0.6 · **What was used instead**: NOT COMPUTABLE (needs range history); PROXY = ATR% in bottom quartile & Perf.3M>0
- **Spec field**: Bonde K avg(close,7)/avg(close,65) · **What was used instead**: PROXY = (close/SMA50 - 1)
- **Spec field**: Bonde K 10-day base · **What was used instead**: PROXY = 1-month base (High.1M-Low.1M)/close
- **Spec field**: Jeff Sun sales_growth_quarterly_yoy > 25 · **What was used instead**: DROPPED (column null on this source)
- **Spec field**: Jeff Sun earnings_growth_quarterly_yoy > 25 · **What was used instead**: SUBSTITUTED by earnings_per_share_diluted_yoy_growth_ttm (TTM not quarterly)
- **Spec field**: velocity_14d (peoplewish) · **What was used instead**: SUBSTITUTED by Perf.1M (calendar month not 14 sessions)
- **Spec field**: Hernandez ETF RS · **What was used instead**: equal-weight median constituent Perf.1M/3M/6M per sector+industry group
